Name: Aizawa as Sebastian
Author: TheDevilRoll
Description:
[b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]
Shota Aizawa is not my original character, all rights go to Kōhei Horikoshi and Hideyuki Furuhashi.

[size=4][b]4.0.0 Update:[/b][/size]
Fixed major game breaking bug where Aizawa would spawn in the middle of town center and lose information about character.
He's now properly labeled as single, his home point has fixed, and he shouldn't lose his information anymore. I recommend using it with a new save considering Character Data had been lost previously and might cause bugs (for example home point looking like park even though in new worlds he is in bed.)  Also is Supported for multiplayer!!



[b][size=4]3.0.0 update:[/size][/b]
[b][i][u]Winter and Beach Sprites/Portraits now properly load.  Shota is now Display name if you haven't updated to the 2.0.0[/u][/i][/b]

[color=#D4D4D8]A small little portrait + sprite mod to turn Sebastian into Shota Aizawa specifically Aizawa from Vigilantes series. This Mod changes every portrait and sprite of Sebastian into Shota Aizawa. Sebastian's name now is changed to Shota in his Portrait and Social Tab[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b]Dialogue can be changed using the "My Hero Valley Conversion" Mod that is now uploaded. Abigial's name is changed to Nemuri already but my sprites for her are not yet ready to upload. they'll be added soon. you can temporarily remove the dialogue for her by using GMCM. This mod will convert dialogue and names when called to their names. for example Sebastian will be labeled as Sho (Nickname) or Shouta depending on if a character would usually say Sebby or Sebastian.[/b][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]This mod is the first mod i've made, and i would love to make more. I've been looking into making a mod of an entire expansion of my hero but i do not have the qualifications and understanding of how to mod that. if there are modders wanting to collab i'd be happy to create the sprites and portraits.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]This is once again my FIRST mod, it is a learning experience and something i will still work on as i learn. because there is only one of me and half a brain cell in the head i'd love to here and comments, suggestions, and bug fixes it may need.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]I do NOT know if this mod works with Maggs Immersive Sebastain Romance or Spicy Expansion. I have not gone through every event with this mod. this atleast works with marriage morning scenes and the first dnd session scene.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Install SMAPI
2. Install Content Patcher
3. Extract this mod into your Stardew Valley Mods folder
4. Launch the game using SMAPI [/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Changes the Portrait and Sprite of Sebastian[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI (4.4.0 or later)[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Content Patcher (2.90 or better)[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Thank you to my best friend who saw me going through this journey. Thank you to anyone who downloads this mod, it makes me feel very grateful.[/color][/size]
